verdict.rationale: Asana documents a first-party RESTful API with a published OpenAPI spec, official JavaScript and Python SDKs, webhooks, and even endpoints for AI Teammates, so broad programmatic coverage is evident. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API reaches full parity with the UI. missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement or coverage map, evidence of API coverage for UI features such as rules, portfolios, goals, and admin settings, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON
This repository contains the OpenAPI Specification for Asana's APIs
Returns the compact records of agents (AI Teammates) configured.
Webhooks allow an application to be notified of changes in Asana.
